chapter: Army years and joining Bunk Johnson
title: New Orleans, then joining Bunk Johnson's band at the Stuyvesant Casino
summary: Ewell works solo and in a small band in New Orleans, rejoins Bunk in spring 1946, and discusses Bunk's leadership, rehearsals, repertoire, introductions and lazy attack.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
